fusions.name: Live Bait Lob
fusions.desc: Lobs a live fish off the side of your ride at the first enemy in its path. It deals 4 damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds, and you move 10% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Bow Wave
fusions.desc: Ploughs your hull forward through a cone 4 tiles long, throwing up a wave of water and darting fish. It deals 12 damage to everything in it and knocks each enemy back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Wriggle Loose
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Riding Carp
fusions.desc: A bonded barge carp swims beside you and fights for you, striking for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds. You can ride it.
